segments.name: Real estate investments
segments.description: Owns gaming and leisure real estate leased to gaming operators under long-term triple-net leases.
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Gaming operator tenants pay rent under long-term triple-net leases for the real estate properties they operate.
revenueModel.evidence: As a REIT, substantially all of our revenues are derived from rent received from tenants under long-term, triple-net leases.
